description: This file contains utility functions for computing CSP hashes for inline scripts in HTML and generating a CSP header string with specific directives, including dynamic inclusion of script hashes.

methods.name: computeInlineScriptHashes
methods.description: Computes SHA-256 hashes for inline <script> blocks in an HTML string, excluding scripts with a 'src' attribute.

methods.name: buildControlUiCspHeader
methods.description: Builds a Content Security Policy (CSP) header string, optionally including hashes for inline scripts.
